transport.play_stop.name: Play / Stop
transport.play_stop.about: Plays from the start marker, or stops where playback is.

transport.pause_continue.name: Stop here / Continue
transport.pause_continue.about: Stops in place, or carries on from the playhead.

transport.go_to_start.name: Go to start
transport.go_to_start.about: Moves the playhead to the start of the song.

transport.panic.name: Panic: silence everything
transport.panic.about: Stops playback and cuts every sound, MIDI notes included; sends All Notes Off on every channel of every MIDI output in use.

transport.record.name: Record
transport.record.about: Records the armed MIDI tracks from the play marker, after the count-in; press again to stop recording.

transport.overdub.name: Overdub
transport.overdub.about: Switches between Replace (a take replaces the clip under it) and Overdub (a take keeps what is under it and adds to it).

transport.count_in_one_bar.name: Count-in: 1 bar
transport.count_in_one_bar.about: Clicks one bar before recording starts.

transport.count_in_two_bars.name: Count-in: 2 bars
transport.count_in_two_bars.about: Clicks two bars before recording starts.

transport.count_in_four_bars.name: Count-in: 4 bars
transport.count_in_four_bars.about: Clicks four bars before recording starts.

transport.metronome_record_only.name: Metronome only while recording
transport.metronome_record_only.about: Keeps the metronome silent except while recording and in the count-in.

transport.follow.name: Follow playhead
transport.follow.about: Keeps the playhead in view while playing.

transport.loop_selection.name: Loop selection
transport.loop_selection.about: Sets the loop to the selected clips or time range and turns it on.

edit.redo.name: Redo
edit.redo.about: Puts back the change just undone.

edit.cut.name: Cut
edit.cut.about: Copies the selected clips or time range, then removes them.

edit.copy.name: Copy
edit.copy.about: Copies the selected clips or time range.

edit.paste.name: Paste
edit.paste.about: Pastes into the time range, or at the playhead.

edit.duplicate.name: Duplicate
edit.duplicate.about: Copies the selection right after itself.

edit.delete.name: Delete
edit.delete.about: Deletes the selected clips, time range, tracks or locator.

edit.delete_time.name: Delete time
edit.delete_time.about: Removes the time range, pulling everything after it back.

edit.insert_time.name: Insert time
edit.insert_time.about: Inserts empty time the length of the range, pushing everything after it on.

edit.deselect.name: Deselect
edit.deselect.about: Clears the clip, range or locator selection.

edit.rename.name: Rename
edit.rename.about: Renames the selected clip, track or locator.

clip.mute.name: Mute clip
clip.mute.about: Mutes the selected clips, or unmutes them.

clip.crossfade.name: Crossfade with previous
clip.crossfade.about: Crossfades the selected audio clip with the audio clip before it for a few milliseconds, or removes that crossfade. Drag the earlier clip's fade handle over the selected clip for a longer one.

file.auto_crossfade.name: Toggle automatic crossfades
file.auto_crossfade.about: Turns short crossfades on or off for eligible audio joins.

clip.properties.name: Clip properties
clip.properties.about: Pins the properties card beside the clip.

clip.add_previous.name: Add previous clip to selection
clip.add_previous.about: Adds the clip before the last one chosen, on its track, to the selection.

clip.add_next.name: Add next clip to selection
clip.add_next.about: Adds the clip after the last one chosen, on its track, to the selection.

track.add_audio.name: Add audio track
track.add_audio.about: Adds an audio track after the selection.

track.add_midi.name: Add MIDI track
track.add_midi.about: Adds a MIDI track after the selection.

track.instrument_poly.name: Instrument: Poly
track.instrument_poly.about: Gives the selected MIDI tracks the built-in synth's Poly sound: two detuned saws, a warm low-pass, a soft attack.

track.instrument_keys.name: Instrument: Keys
track.instrument_keys.about: Gives the selected MIDI tracks the built-in synth's Keys sound: soft, quick to speak, fading while held.

track.instrument_bass.name: Instrument: Bass
track.instrument_bass.about: Gives the selected MIDI tracks the built-in synth's Bass sound: a saw and a square an octave down, closed low-pass.

track.instrument_pluck.name: Instrument: Pluck
track.instrument_pluck.about: Gives the selected MIDI tracks the built-in synth's Pluck sound: short and bright, no sustain.

track.instrument_pad.name: Instrument: Pad
track.instrument_pad.about: Gives the selected MIDI tracks the built-in synth's Pad sound: slow attack, long release.

track.midi_to_instrument.name: MIDI To: Instrument
track.midi_to_instrument.about: Plays the selected MIDI tracks on their own instrument, not on a MIDI output port.

midi.computer_keyboard.name: Computer keyboard
midi.computer_keyboard.about: Plays notes from the letter keys: A to K, W E T Y U for the black keys, Z X octave, C V velocity.

track.midi_from_all.name: MIDI From: All inputs
track.midi_from_all.about: Lets the selected MIDI tracks listen to every MIDI input switched on for tracks, and the computer keyboard.

track.midi_from_keyboard.name: MIDI From: Computer keyboard
track.midi_from_keyboard.about: Lets the selected MIDI tracks listen to the computer keyboard only.

track.monitor_in.name: Monitor: In
track.monitor_in.about: The selected MIDI tracks always play what is played live.

track.monitor_auto.name: Monitor: Auto
track.monitor_auto.about: The selected MIDI tracks play what is played live while they are armed or selected.

track.monitor_off.name: Monitor: Off
track.monitor_off.about: The selected MIDI tracks never play what is played live.

track.group.name: Group tracks
track.group.about: Puts the selected tracks into a new group track.

track.ungroup.name: Ungroup
track.ungroup.about: Removes the selected group, keeping its tracks; or takes the selected tracks out of their group.

track.move_up.name: Move track up
track.move_up.about: Moves the selected tracks one place up, within their group.

track.move_down.name: Move track down
track.move_down.about: Moves the selected tracks one place down, within their group.

track.select_above.name: Select above
track.select_above.about: Selects the track above; with a clip selected, the nearest clip on the track above.

track.select_below.name: Select below
track.select_below.about: Selects the track below; with a clip selected, the nearest clip on the track below.

track.extend_up.name: Add above to selection
track.extend_up.about: Adds the track above to the selection; with clips selected, the nearest clip above.

track.extend_down.name: Add below to selection
track.extend_down.about: Adds the track below to the selection; with clips selected, the nearest clip below.

track.fold.name: Previous clip or fold track
track.fold.about: With a clip selected, selects the clip before it on its track; with tracks selected, folds them (a group hides its tracks).

track.unfold.name: Next clip or unfold track
track.unfold.about: With a clip selected, selects the clip after it on its track; with tracks selected, unfolds them (a group shows its tracks).

track.fold_groups.name: Fold all groups
track.fold_groups.about: Hides the tracks inside every group track.

track.unfold_groups.name: Unfold all groups
track.unfold_groups.about: Shows the tracks inside every group track.

mixer.solo.name: Solo selected tracks
mixer.solo.about: Solos the selected tracks, or unsolos them.

mixer.mute.name: Mute selected tracks
mixer.mute.about: Mutes the selected tracks, or unmutes them.

mixer.clear_solos.name: Clear all solos
mixer.clear_solos.about: Unsolos every track, so everything not muted is heard again.

mixer.additive_solo.name: Additive solo
mixer.additive_solo.about: A click on Solo adds the track to what is soloed; Ctrl+click solos it alone.

mixer.clear_clips.name: Clear clip lights
mixer.clear_clips.about: Turns off every meter's red clip light and resets the peak holds.

mixer.track_colour_meters.name: Meters in track colors
mixer.track_colour_meters.about: Meters take their track's color instead of the accent; above −6 dB they still turn amber, and red past full scale.

mixer.pan_law_constant_power.name: Pan law: −3 dB, constant power
mixer.pan_law_constant_power.about: A centered mono track plays 3 dB down per side, so its level stays even across the sweep. The default. Stereo tracks keep their level at the center.

mixer.pan_law_compromise.name: Pan law: −4.5 dB
mixer.pan_law_compromise.about: A centered mono track plays 4.5 dB down per side: between constant power and linear. Stereo tracks keep their level at the center.

mixer.pan_law_linear.name: Pan law: −6 dB, linear
mixer.pan_law_linear.about: A centered mono track plays 6 dB down per side; the two sides always add up to unity. Stereo tracks keep their level at the center.

mixer.pan_law_balance.name: Pan law: 0 dB, balance
mixer.pan_law_balance.about: A centered mono track plays at unity on both sides; panning turns only the far side down. Stereo tracks always pan this way.

view.zoom_in.name: Zoom in
view.zoom_in.about: Zooms in around the pointer, or the playhead. With the clip editor's keys live, zooms its piano roll.

view.zoom_out.name: Zoom out
view.zoom_out.about: Zooms out around the pointer, or the playhead. With the clip editor's keys live, zooms its piano roll.

view.zoom_back.name: Zoom back
view.zoom_back.about: Goes back to the view before the last zoom.

view.fit_width.name: Fit song to width
view.fit_width.about: Fits the whole song to the window's width.

view.fit_height.name: Fit tracks to height
view.fit_height.about: Fits every track into the window's height, or back.

view.zoom_selection.name: Zoom to selection
view.zoom_selection.about: Fits the selected clips or time range to the window.

view.fit_loop.name: Fit loop
view.fit_loop.about: Fits the loop to the window.

view.detail_panel.name: Show / hide detail panel
view.detail_panel.about: Shows or hides the detail panel.

view.info_line.name: Show info line
view.info_line.about: Shows or hides the line along the bottom that says what is under the pointer.

view.palette.name: Command palette
view.palette.about: Finds any command by name, and runs it.

view.next_pane.name: Next pane
view.next_pane.about: Moves the keyboard to the next pane: browser, arrangement, detail.

view.previous_pane.name: Previous pane
view.previous_pane.about: Moves the keyboard to the previous pane.

grid.triplet.name: Triplet grid
grid.triplet.about: Switches the grid to triplets, or back.

grid.snap.name: Snap to grid
grid.snap.about: Turns snapping to the grid on or off.

grid.fixed.name: Fixed grid
grid.fixed.about: Keeps the grid at its size whatever the zoom, or lets it adapt.

locators.set.name: Set locator
locators.set.about: Adds a locator at the playhead, or removes the one there.

file.save_as.name: Save as…
file.save_as.about: Saves the project under a new name or place.

file.import_audio.name: Import audio or MIDI…
file.import_audio.about: Adds audio or MIDI files at the playhead: onto the selected track when it takes them (audio on audio tracks, MIDI on MIDI tracks), or onto new tracks after the selection.

file.export_midi.name: Export MIDI file…
file.export_midi.about: Writes the project's MIDI tracks to a Standard MIDI File: a track for each, with the tempo and time signature.

file.shortcuts.name: Keyboard shortcuts
file.shortcuts.about: Shows every shortcut on a keyboard, and changes them.

midi.create_clip.name: Create MIDI clip
midi.create_clip.about: Puts an empty MIDI clip on the first selected MIDI track, else the first MIDI track of the time range, else the track last clicked. Over the time range if there is one, else one bar at the edit position. Opens it in the clip editor.

midi.export_clip.name: Export MIDI clip…
midi.export_clip.about: Writes the selected MIDI clips, as they play, to a Standard MIDI File.

midi.open_editor.name: Open clip
midi.open_editor.about: Opens the selected clip in the Clip tab of the detail panel: an audio clip's properties beside its wave, a MIDI clip's notes.

midi.pop_out_editor.name: Pop out clip editor
midi.pop_out_editor.about: Moves the clip editor into its own window, or docks it back into the detail panel.

midi.draw_tool.name: Draw tool
midi.draw_tool.about: Toggles Pointer and Draw in the arrangement or active editor. In the note editor, click to add a note and drag to set its length.

midi.split_notes.name: Split
midi.split_notes.about: Splits selected clips or a time range at the edit cursor; in the clip editor, splits selected notes.

midi.glue_notes.name: Join
midi.glue_notes.about: Joins selected notes of one pitch that touch or overlap into one. With clips selected, joins them: MIDI clips merge, audio clips that continue one another in their source become one, and other audio clips are rendered into one new file.

midi.legato.name: Legato
midi.legato.about: Lengthens each selected note to the start of the next one.

midi.transpose_up.name: Transpose up
midi.transpose_up.about: Moves the selected notes up a semitone. In the clip editor the Up arrow does it.

midi.transpose_down.name: Transpose down
midi.transpose_down.about: Moves the selected notes down a semitone. In the clip editor the Down arrow does it.

midi.octave_up.name: Transpose up an octave
midi.octave_up.about: Moves the selected notes up an octave. In the clip editor Shift+Up does it.

midi.octave_down.name: Transpose down an octave
midi.octave_down.about: Moves the selected notes down an octave. In the clip editor Shift+Down does it.

midi.nudge_earlier.name: Nudge notes earlier
midi.nudge_earlier.about: Moves the selected notes one grid step earlier. In the clip editor the Left arrow does it.

midi.nudge_later.name: Nudge notes later
midi.nudge_later.about: Moves the selected notes one grid step later. In the clip editor the Right arrow does it.

midi.nudge_earlier_fine.name: Nudge notes earlier, finely
midi.nudge_earlier_fine.about: Moves the selected notes earlier by the shortest note, a 128th. With clips selected in the arrangement it moves them one grid step.

midi.nudge_later_fine.name: Nudge notes later, finely
midi.nudge_later_fine.about: Moves the selected notes later by the shortest note, a 128th. With clips selected in the arrangement it moves them one grid step.

midi.toggle_lane.name: Velocity and controller lane
midi.toggle_lane.about: Shows or hides the lane under the notes in the clip editor, where velocities and controllers are drawn.

midi.lane_velocity.name: Velocity lane
midi.lane_velocity.about: Shows the notes' velocities in the lane under the clip editor.

midi.lane_mod_wheel.name: Mod wheel lane
midi.lane_mod_wheel.about: Shows the mod wheel (controller 1) in the lane under the clip editor.

midi.lane_pitch_bend.name: Pitch bend lane
midi.lane_pitch_bend.about: Shows pitch bend in the lane under the clip editor.

midi.lane_pressure.name: Pressure lane
midi.lane_pressure.about: Shows channel pressure (aftertouch) in the lane under the clip editor.

midi.lane_pencil.name: Lane pencil
midi.lane_pencil.about: Draws values freehand in the lane. A click sets one value.

midi.lane_line.name: Lane line
midi.lane_line.about: Draws a straight line between two values in the lane.

midi.lane_curve.name: Lane curve
midi.lane_curve.about: Draws a line in the lane, then drag its dot to bend it.

midi.raise_velocity.name: Raise velocity
midi.raise_velocity.about: Raises the velocity of the selected notes by 8.

midi.lower_velocity.name: Lower velocity
midi.lower_velocity.about: Lowers the velocity of the selected notes by 8.

midi.quantize.name: Quantize
midi.quantize.about: Moves the selected notes (every note if none are selected) toward the grid with the last quantize settings.

midi.quantize_options.name: Quantize options
midi.quantize_options.about: Opens the quantize settings, and shows what they will do before you apply them.

midi.humanize.name: Humanize notes
midi.humanize.about: Loosens the timing and velocity of the selected notes (every note if none are selected) a little, at random.

midi.fixed_length.name: Fixed length
midi.fixed_length.about: Gives the selected notes (every note if none are selected) the length of one grid step.

midi.scale_constrain.name: Constrain to scale
midi.scale_constrain.about: Moves the selected notes (every note if none are selected) onto the last scale chosen from the editor's menu, C major to begin with.

midi.reverse.name: Reverse notes
midi.reverse.about: Plays the selected notes (every note if none are selected) backwards: the last becomes the first.

devices.search.name: Search devices
devices.search.about: Opens the browser and puts the keyboard in its search field.

devices.rescan.name: Rescan plugins
devices.rescan.about: Looks for new and changed plugins in the plugin folders. Plugins that did not change are not loaded again.

devices.rescan_all.name: Rescan all plugins
devices.rescan_all.about: Loads every plugin again, ignoring what was learned before, blocked ones included.

devices.add_folder.name: Add plugin folder…
devices.add_folder.about: Adds a folder to search for plugins, besides the standard ones, and scans it.

devices.favorite.name: Favorite device
devices.favorite.about: Stars or unstars the device selected in the browser.

devices.scan_at_startup.name: Scan plugins at startup
devices.scan_at_startup.about: Looks for new and changed plugins in the background each time the app starts. Off, the list changes only when you rescan.

devices.add.name: Add device to selected track
devices.add.about: Puts the device chosen in the browser on the selected track (after the chosen card), or on a new track when none fits.

devices.remove.name: Remove device
devices.remove.about: Takes the chosen device off its track. Undo puts it back with its settings.

devices.bypass.name: Bypass device
devices.bypass.about: Turns the chosen device off, or on again. A bypassed device keeps its delay, so nothing shifts in time.

devices.move_earlier.name: Move device earlier
devices.move_earlier.about: Moves the chosen device one place toward the start of its chain. Alt+Left does the same while the Devices tab has the keyboard.

devices.move_later.name: Move device later
devices.move_later.about: Moves the chosen device one place toward the end of its chain. Alt+Right does the same while the Devices tab has the keyboard.

devices.copy.name: Copy device
devices.copy.about: Keeps the chosen device with its settings, to paste on any track. Ctrl+C does the same while the Devices tab has the keyboard.

devices.paste.name: Paste device
devices.paste.about: Puts the copied device on the shown track, after the chosen card. It is a new device with the copied settings. Ctrl+V does the same while the Devices tab has the keyboard.

devices.duplicate.name: Duplicate device
devices.duplicate.about: Copies the chosen device right after itself. Ctrl+D does the same while the Devices tab has the keyboard.

devices.fold.name: Fold device
devices.fold.about: Folds the chosen card to a narrow strip, or opens it again. Double-clicking a card does the same.

devices.parameters.name: Device parameters
devices.parameters.about: Opens every parameter of the chosen plugin, with search. A star puts a parameter on the card's strip.

devices.editor.name: Open or close the plugin's own window
devices.editor.about: Opens the chosen plugin's own window where it was last, or closes it. The window belongs to the plugin; a plugin that stops answering can be ended from its card.

devices.learn.name: Learn a parameter from the plugin's window
devices.learn.about: Opens the plugin's window and puts the next control you touch there on the next free slot of the card's strip. Run it again, or press Esc, to stop.

devices.leave_safe_mode.name: Leave safe mode
devices.leave_safe_mode.about: Ends safe mode: the plugins start loading, each as it would have, and the app looks for new ones as set in the settings. A plugin that stopped the app loading last time may do so again.

devices.preset.name: Choose a preset for the plugin
devices.preset.about: Opens the chosen plugin's preset menu: its own factory programs and the preset files saved for it, with a search. The arrows beside the name step to the previous and next.

devices.save_preset.name: Save the plugin's sound as a preset
devices.save_preset.about: Saves the chosen plugin's sound as a preset file. A sound that came from one of your own preset files is saved over it; otherwise it asks for a name and never writes over a file.

devices.sidechain.name: Choose the sidechain of the effect
devices.sidechain.about: Opens the chosen plugin effect's sidechain menu: which track keys it, and where on that track the signal is taken (before its devices, after them, or what it plays). Only an effect with a sidechain input has one.

devices.outputs.name: Choose the outputs of the instrument
devices.outputs.about: Opens the chosen plugin instrument's outputs menu: a switch for each output besides the main one. Turning one on makes an audio track for it under the instrument's track; turning it off takes the track away. Only an instrument with several outputs has one.

view.automation.name: Show or hide automation lanes
view.automation.about: Shows the automation lane over the selected tracks' clips, or hides it. The lane draws one parameter of the track, volume to begin with; click it to add points.

view.automation_parameter.name: Choose the automation parameter
view.automation_parameter.about: Opens the list of parameters the shown lane can draw: volume, pan, trim, mute and the track's sends.

edit.automation_point.name: Add an automation point at the playhead
edit.automation_point.about: Adds a point to the shown lane at the playhead, holding the value the lane has there. With the point picked, the arrows move it and Delete takes it away.

view.automation_on.name: Turn the automation lane on or off
view.automation_on.about: Switches the shown lane on or off, keeping its points. A lane that is off plays nothing and the control keeps the value it was set to.

edit.automation_remove.name: Remove the automation lane
edit.automation_remove.about: Takes the shown lane away, points and all.

edit.automation_segment_linear.name: Make the automation segments straight
edit.automation_segment_linear.about: The segments leaving the picked automation points run in a straight line to the next point.

edit.automation_segment_step.name: Make the automation segments steps
edit.automation_segment_step.about: The segments leaving the picked automation points hold their value until the next point, then jump.

edit.automation_segment_curve.name: Make the automation segments curved
edit.automation_segment_curve.about: The segments leaving the picked automation points follow a smooth S curve. Pick one point and drag the dot on its segment to bend it.

edit.automation_tool_ramp.name: Automation tool: ramp
edit.automation_tool_ramp.about: Drag across the shown lane to draw a straight ramp from where you press to where you let go.

edit.automation_tool_sine.name: Automation tool: sine
edit.automation_tool_sine.about: Drag across the shown lane to draw a sine wave, one cycle to a grid step, between the height you press at and the height you let go at.

edit.automation_tool_triangle.name: Automation tool: triangle
edit.automation_tool_triangle.about: Drag across the shown lane to draw a triangle wave, one cycle to a grid step.

edit.automation_tool_saw.name: Automation tool: saw
edit.automation_tool_saw.about: Drag across the shown lane to draw a saw wave that rises over each grid step and drops at its end.

edit.automation_tool_square.name: Automation tool: square
edit.automation_tool_square.about: Drag across the shown lane to draw a square wave, one cycle to a grid step, as steps.

edit.automation_reenable.name: Re-enable the automation lane
edit.automation_reenable.about: Lets the shown lane play again after you moved a control it drives. The control follows the lane once more.

edit.automation_reenable_all.name: Re-enable all automation lanes
edit.automation_reenable_all.about: Lets every lane you took over by moving its control play again.

edit.automation_mode_read.name: Automation mode: Read
edit.automation_mode_read.about: The selected tracks play their lanes, and a control you move takes its lane over.

edit.automation_mode_touch.name: Automation mode: Touch
edit.automation_mode_touch.about: The selected tracks write their lanes while you hold a control during playback, and return to the lane when you let go.

edit.automation_mode_latch.name: Automation mode: Latch
edit.automation_mode_latch.about: The selected tracks start writing at your first touch during playback and go on until Stop.

edit.automation_mode_write.name: Automation mode: Write
edit.automation_mode_write.about: The selected tracks overwrite their lanes with the controls' values from where playing starts until Stop. Show the lane you want to write (A) first, or use one that exists.

midi.learn.name: Learn a controller for the shown lane's control
midi.learn.about: Waits for you to move a knob or fader on a MIDI controller, then maps it to the control the shown automation lane draws (show it with A). Run it again, or press Esc, to stop waiting.

midi.clear_mapping.name: Clear the controller mapping of the shown lane's control
midi.clear_mapping.about: Takes away the controller that moves the control the shown automation lane draws.

midi.mappings.name: Controller mappings
midi.mappings.about: Opens the list of controller mappings in the project: which knob moves which control. Each can be cleared there.

view.song_lanes.name: Show or hide the tempo and meter lanes
view.song_lanes.about: Shows or hides the tempo and time-signature lanes under the bar ruler. Click the tempo lane to add a change, drag a point to move it, double-click it to type a tempo; click the meter lane to add a time signature on a bar line.

edit.tempo_change.name: Add a tempo change at the playhead
edit.tempo_change.about: Adds a tempo change at the playhead, at the tempo already playing there, and asks for the new tempo. The tempo lane is shown if it is hidden.

edit.meter_change.name: Add a time signature change at the playhead
edit.meter_change.about: Adds a time signature change on the bar line nearest the playhead and asks for it, as 7/8. The meter lane is shown if it is hidden.

edit.tempo_ramp.name: Ramp or hold the picked tempo change
edit.tempo_ramp.about: Makes the picked tempo change glide to the tempo of the next change in a straight line, or hold its own tempo until the next change again. The last change has no next change to glide to.

view.clip_envelope.name: Show or hide the clip's envelope
view.clip_envelope.about: Shows the gain envelope of the selected audio clip over it, or hides it. Click the clip to add a point, drag a point to move it; the chip at the envelope's corner switches between gain and pan. Points move with the clip.

edit.lock_envelopes.name: Lock envelopes
edit.lock_envelopes.about: With this off, moving, copying or deleting a clip also moves, copies or removes the track's automation under it. With it on, automation stays where it is on the timeline.

view.tool_pointer.name: Pointer tool
view.tool_pointer.about: Selects and moves clips and time ranges.

view.tool_draw.name: Arrangement draw tool
view.tool_draw.about: Draws MIDI clips in empty MIDI lanes. B switches between it and Pointer.

view.tool_erase.name: Erase tool
view.tool_erase.about: Deletes the clip under the pointer.

view.tool_split.name: Split tool
view.tool_split.about: Cuts clips at the pointer or at the edit cursor.

view.tool_mute.name: Mute tool
view.tool_mute.about: Toggles mute on the clip under the pointer.

view.tool_zoom.name: Zoom tool
view.tool_zoom.about: Zooms to a time range dragged in the arrangement.

edit.crop.name: Crop to selection
edit.crop.about: Keeps the selected time range and removes the rest of the selected tracks' clips.

clip.unloop.name: Unloop
clip.unloop.about: Turns the selected looping clips into real clips, one for each repeat.

clip.nudge_earlier.name: Nudge clips earlier
clip.nudge_earlier.about: Moves the selected clips one grid step earlier. Alt+Left does it when clips are selected in the arrangement.

clip.nudge_later.name: Nudge clips later
clip.nudge_later.about: Moves the selected clips one grid step later. Alt+Right does it when clips are selected in the arrangement.

clip.nudge_earlier_fine.name: Nudge clips earlier, finely
clip.nudge_earlier_fine.about: Moves the selected clips earlier by the shortest note, a 128th.

clip.nudge_later_fine.name: Nudge clips later, finely
clip.nudge_later_fine.about: Moves the selected clips later by the shortest note, a 128th.

edit.select_invert.name: Invert selection
edit.select_invert.about: Selects the clips that are not selected and deselects the rest.

edit.select_in_track.name: Select all in track
edit.select_in_track.about: Selects every clip on the tracks that hold a selected clip, or on the selected tracks.

edit.select_to_start.name: Select to start
edit.select_to_start.about: Adds the clips from the start of the song up to the latest selected clip, on the selected clips' tracks.

edit.select_to_end.name: Select to end
edit.select_to_end.about: Adds the clips from the earliest selected clip to the end of the song, on the selected clips' tracks.

clip.reverse.name: Reverse
clip.reverse.about: Plays the selected audio clips backwards, or forwards again. Each keeps its place and plays the same stretch of its file the other way round.

clip.polarity.name: Invert polarity
clip.polarity.about: Inverts the polarity of the selected audio clips, or puts it back.

clip.normalize.name: Normalize
clip.normalize.about: Sets the gain of the selected audio clips so the loudest sample of the stretch each plays reaches full scale. The audio file is not changed.

clip.consolidate.name: Join into new file
clip.consolidate.about: Renders the selected audio clips of each track, first start to last end with gaps as silence, into one new file that one clip plays. Gain, polarity, reverse, fades, crossfades and envelopes are baked in; the track's fader, pan and devices are not. Originals stay in the media pool. Esc stops it.

clip.bounce.name: Bounce
clip.bounce.about: Renders the selected tracks, over the time range, the selected clips or the whole track, into a new audio file with the track's own sound (its plugins, fader and pan too if Include effects is on), on the track or a new one. A tail that rings on after the end is kept. Esc stops it.

track.freeze.name: Freeze track
track.freeze.about: Renders the selected audio and MIDI tracks, instrument and devices included, into a file played instead, so no plugin runs. Fader, pan, sends, mute and solo stay live; clips, notes and devices are read-only until unfrozen. Tracks tied to others (a sidechain, extra outputs) cannot freeze. Esc stops it.

track.unfreeze.name: Unfreeze track
track.unfreeze.about: Gives a frozen track back its clips, notes, instrument and devices, exactly as they were. The rendered file stays in the media pool.

track.flatten.name: Flatten track
track.flatten.about: Turns a frozen track into a plain audio track that holds the rendered file. Its clips, notes, instrument and devices are removed; its name, color, fader, pan, sends and output stay. A MIDI track becomes an audio track. Undo brings everything back.

track.input_next.name: Next track input
track.input_next.about: Steps the selected audio tracks to the next input of the audio device: none, each stereo pair, then each mono input. Arming a track without an input picks the first free one for you.

track.monitor_next.name: Next monitor mode
track.monitor_next.about: Steps the selected audio tracks through Auto, In and Off. Auto plays what the input hears while the track is armed and the transport is stopped or recording; In always does; Off never does.

clip.take_next.name: Play next take
clip.take_next.about: Plays the next take of the selected clips that have takes (a loop recording keeps every pass), round the set. The clip stays where it is; only the pass it plays changes.

clip.take_previous.name: Play previous take
clip.take_previous.about: Plays the take before the one playing on the selected clips that have takes, round the set.

clip.take_keep.name: Keep only this take
clip.take_keep.about: Throws away the other takes of the selected clips and keeps the one each plays. Audio stays in the media pool. Undo brings the takes back.

transport.capture_midi.name: Capture MIDI
transport.capture_midi.about: Turns the notes you last played on a MIDI track, while not recording, into a clip. Played while the song moved, they land where you heard them; played while stopped, the first lands on the playhead. Nothing under the clip is lost. The last ten minutes of playing are kept, in memory only.

transport.keep_played_notes.name: Keep played notes for Capture MIDI
transport.keep_played_notes.about: Keeps the notes you play on MIDI tracks while not recording, in memory for ten minutes, so Capture MIDI can turn them into a clip. Off, nothing is kept and what was kept is forgotten.

file.save_copy.name: Save a copy…
file.save_copy.about: Saves a complete copy of the project, with every audio file it uses, under a new name or in a new place, and leaves this project as it is: it keeps its own file, its unsaved changes and its place in the recent list. Esc stops it.

file.collect_and_save.name: Collect and save
file.collect_and_save.about: Copies every audio file from outside the project's folder into Samples/Imported, then saves, so the project can be moved or shared. Missing files are listed and left as they are. Esc stops it; the project file is written last, so a stopped collect changes nothing.

file.save_template.name: Save as template…
file.save_template.about: Keeps this project, with all its audio, as a template to start new projects from. Asks for a name; a name that is already a template is replaced when you confirm. The template holds everything in the project and none of its undo history.

file.open_templates_folder.name: Open templates folder
file.open_templates_folder.about: Shows the folder the templates are kept in. To rename or delete a template, rename or delete its folder there.

file.revert.name: Revert to saved…
file.revert.about: Drops every change since the last save and reads the saved project back, plugin state included. Asks first. The unsaved version is put away in the project's Backups/Reverted folder before anything is dropped, and a message offers to open it.

file.project_settings.name: Project settings…
file.project_settings.about: Opens the project's own settings: the sample rate of the files the app makes for it, the pan law, automatic crossfades, the color new tracks take, and notes about the project. Each change is saved in the project and is one undo step.

file.media_pool.name: Project media
file.media_pool.about: Shows the browser's Project media tab: every audio file the project holds, which ones are missing, which ones nothing plays, and files left behind that belong to no project.

file.locate_media.name: Locate missing media…
file.locate_media.about: Asks for the file that stands in for the missing audio chosen in the Project media tab. A file of another length, or with another channel count or sample rate, is checked before anything changes. Relinking is saved with the project and is not an undo step.

file.search_folder_for_media.name: Search a folder for missing media…
file.search_folder_for_media.about: Looks in the folder you choose, and in the folders inside it, for the audio the project cannot find, by file name. It shows what it found and changes nothing until you relink. Esc stops it.

file.remove_unused_media.name: Remove unused media
file.remove_unused_media.about: Takes the audio files no clip and no frozen track plays out of the project, as one undo step. The files stay where they are.

file.clear_stray_files.name: Clear files that belong to no project…
file.clear_stray_files.about: Moves audio left behind in the project's sample folders and in the work folders for renders and recordings, which no project and no autosave needs, to the system trash. Asks once more before it moves anything; the trash can give them back.

file.export_audio.name: Export audio…
file.export_audio.about: Exports the master mix or track, group and return stems to WAV or FLAC, from the project, loop or time selection, with a loudness report. Esc stops an export.

view.show_devices.name: Show devices
view.show_devices.about: Shows the Devices tab of the detail panel: the chain of the track named at its left, the one whose header or clip was clicked last.

view.show_clip.name: Show clip
view.show_clip.about: Shows the Clip tab of the detail panel: the opened clip's properties and wave, or its notes.

view.show_mixer.name: Show mixer
view.show_mixer.about: Shows the Mixer tab of the detail panel: every track's channel strip.

transport.measure_latency.name: Measure recording latency…
transport.measure_latency.about: Opens Preferences at the loopback helper on the Audio page: with a cable from an output to an input, five clicks measure how long sound takes to go out and come back, and the difference from what the driver reports can become the recording offset, so takes land where they were played.

transport.loop.name: Loop on or off
transport.loop.about: Turns looping between the loop brace's edges on or off.

transport.metronome.name: Metronome on or off
transport.metronome.about: Turns the metronome's click on or off.

transport.punch_in.name: Punch in at the loop start
transport.punch_in.about: While on, a take leaves out what is recorded before the loop's start.

transport.punch_out.name: Punch out at the loop end
transport.punch_out.about: While on, a take leaves out what is recorded after the loop's end.

transport.go_to_end.name: Go to end
transport.go_to_end.about: Moves the playhead to the end of the last clip, or to the loop's end when the loop is on and ends later.

transport.audio_on.name: Audio on or off
transport.audio_on.about: Closes the audio device so other applications can use it, or opens it again.

view.time_format.name: Next time format
view.time_format.about: Shows the time ruler in the next format: minutes and seconds, samples or timecode.

view.browser.name: Show or hide the browser
view.browser.about: Shows or hides the browser at the left: devices and the project's media.

mixer.cue_mode.name: Solo or Cue
mixer.cue_mode.about: Switches the tracks' S buttons between solo and cue: on Cue they send the track to the headphones, before its fader.

track.add_return.name: Add return track
track.add_return.about: Adds a return track after the last one, for sends to share an effect.

track.add_group.name: Add group track
track.add_group.about: Adds an empty group track after the selected track. To put tracks into a new group, select them and use Group tracks.

file.preferences.name: Preferences…
file.preferences.about: Opens Preferences on the page shown last: audio and MIDI devices, recording, editing, mixing, plugins, files and appearance. Type a word to find any setting. Changes apply at once and are kept for every project.

file.preferences_audio.name: Audio settings…
file.preferences_audio.about: Opens Preferences on the Audio page: the driver, the device, its sample rate and buffer, its channels, latency and the test tone.

file.preferences_midi.name: MIDI settings…
file.preferences_midi.about: Opens Preferences on the MIDI page: every MIDI input and output with its switches.

file.preferences_plugins.name: Plugin settings…
file.preferences_plugins.about: Opens Preferences on the Plugins page: the folders searched for plugins, and scanning.

file.history.name: History
file.history.about: Shows every step that can be undone or redone; click one to go back or forward to it.

transport.tap_tempo.name: Tap tempo
transport.tap_tempo.about: Tap in time: from the third tap the tempo where the run started follows, rounded to a whole BPM. A pause of 3 seconds ends the run, and each run undoes in one step.

transport.sound_check.name: Play test sound
transport.sound_check.about: Plays a short chime on the main outputs: a note on the left, one on the right, then one on both, so you can tell that both speakers work and are the right way round. Stop silences it.

view.browse_devices.name: Browse devices
view.browse_devices.about: Shows the browser's Devices tab: the instruments and effects to add to a track.

view.browse_samples.name: Browse samples
view.browse_samples.about: Shows the browser's Samples tab: every audio and MIDI file in your sample folders, to find, hear and drag onto a track.

view.browse_projects.name: Browse projects
view.browse_projects.about: Shows the browser's Projects tab: recent projects and the projects folder.

view.browse_places.name: Browse places
view.browse_places.about: Shows the browser's Places tab: the folders you added and this computer's drives, to browse for files.

view.preview_file.name: Preview file
view.preview_file.about: Plays the sound chosen in the browser's Samples or Places tab from its start, on the cue pair when there is one. In the list, Shift+Enter does the same.

view.stop_preview.name: Stop preview
view.stop_preview.about: Stops the browser's preview. Leaving the file tabs stops it too; the song's Play does not.

view.add_sample_folder.name: Add a sample folder…
view.add_sample_folder.about: Chooses a folder whose audio and MIDI files the Samples tab lists, with every folder inside it.

view.add_place.name: Add a place…
view.add_place.about: Chooses a folder to keep in the Places tab, to browse it without looking for it again.

view.refresh_files.name: Refresh the browser's files
view.refresh_files.about: Reads the sample folders, the projects folder and the open place again, for files added or removed outside the app.
